product.name: Borealis Cold IPA
product.tagline: Crisp as Sub-Zero Glaciers. Explosive as West Coast Hops.

specs.glassware: Nordic Stemmed Tulip or Willi Becher

malts: Single-origin German Barke Pilsner Malt (crisp foundation)
Toasted Puffed Jasmine Rice (creates bone-dry, refreshing mouthfeel)
Acidulated Malt (pure pH balance for hop vibrancy)
hops: Citra Cryo (concentrated lupulin, pink grapefruit & mango burst)
Nelson Sauvin (New Zealand harvest, white wine & crushed gooseberry)
Idaho 7 & Simcoe (late dry-hop for delicate pine & resin snap)
ingredients.yeast: Authentic Bavarian Lager Yeast (W-34/70) fermented warm under pressure (58°F)
ingredients.water: Glacial soft water treated with calcium sulfate for surgical hop clarity

tastingNotes.title: Zesty Citrus & White Peach
tastingNotes.description: Bright burst of freshly squeezed ruby red grapefruit, white peach blossom, and passionfruit peel.

tastingNotes.title: Nordic Pine & Crushed Gooseberry
tastingNotes.description: Crisp alpine pine needle undertones backed by Nelson Sauvin's signature white wine minerality.

tastingNotes.title: Ultra-Dry Glacial Snap
tastingNotes.description: Bone-dry, champagne-like carbonation cleanses the palate instantly, leaving zero cloying sweetness.

foodPairings.dish: Charred Smash Burger with Aged White Cheddar
foodPairings.why: High carbonation and bright hop acidity cut through rich beef fat and creamy aged cheese.
Citrus aromas elevate the smoky salmon oils without overpowering delicate flaky fish.

foodPairings.dish: Spicy Thai Green Papaya Salad (Som Tum)
foodPairings.why: Crisp 48 IBU bitterness and cold-ferment finish soothe bird's eye chili heat effortlessly.

foodPairings.dish: Woodfired Margherita Pizza with Fresh Basil
foodPairings.why: Clean pilsner malt foundation echoes blistered sourdough crust while hops elevate fresh basil.
